verdict.rationale: Shopify's own docs say merchants can accept wallets from day one and promote a 'one-click checkout', which covers the core of accelerated, low-friction payment. The evidence never names the specific wallets or explains how buyer details are reused, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal support, details of how saved buyer information skips re-entry, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can pay with accelerated wallets — Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, platform one-click — without re-entering details

citations.quote: Accept cards, wallets, installments, and crypto—from day one.
The world's highest-converting, customizable, one-click checkout powers 12% of US ecommerce
